newsitem.title: USA: Aaron Rents sees franchised stores rising.
newsitem.headline: Aaron Rents sees franchised stores rising.

text.p: Aaron Rents Inc said Wednesday it expects revenues will exceed $300 million in 1997 and that franchised rental/purchase stores will increase from the current 63 to more than 100.
The company said it opened its 300th store during the fourth quarter, an increase of more than 20 percent in the past year.
Aaron is a furniture rental and sales company and also manufactures furniture. The company says it is increasing its presence in the rental/purchase industry.

The company also said it has authorized the repurchase of one million shares, or 5.1 percent of the 19.6 million shares outstanding. Under a previous authorization, the company has repurchased over 500,000 shares over the past three fiscal years.
Aaron last week reported record revenues and earnings for both the 1996 fourth quarter and year.
